remarks: Tucked along a quiet cul-de-sac street, 6 Clara Drive offers a setting that feels welcoming, neighborly, and easy to call home. This well-maintained single-family residence has been lovingly cared for over the years, and that pride of ownership is evident throughout. The main level features a full living room filled with natural light, a peaceful den ideal for movie nights or quiet evenings in, and a full-size dining room designed for gatherings both big and small. The functional kitchen opens to a screened sunroom, creating a comfortable space to enjoy morning coffee, warm afternoons, and the changing seasons. A full bath on the main level adds everyday convenience. Upstairs, three comfortable bedrooms and an additional full bath provide a practical and well-balanced layout. An under-house garage and a large basement offer valuable storage and flexible space for hobbies, projects, or future use. Outside, a manageable yard keeps upkeep simple, while the cul-de-sac street encourages a calm atmosphere and a true sense of community. Ideally located near Stew Leonard's, the shops and services along Westport Avenue, and major commuting routes, this home delivers both neighborhood charm and everyday accessibility. Step inside and see how easily this home fits the way you live.
